pc_changelog:
v4.5.3 — Reliable Phone Sync & Lighter on Memory

• Your newest three copies always reach your phone: after it was offline, asleep or in the background, it catches up on exactly those three, never the whole history
• Text reaches the phone's floating clipboard straight away, even while the app is in the background
• A copy made between two checks is no longer missed, and your own copies no longer bounce back from the phone and push newer ones out of sync
• Notes written on the phone arrive as their own card on that day; an entry edited on both devices keeps the latest edit
• Phone edits to notes and to-dos are no longer ignored for hours because of time zones
• FlyShelf frees memory right after you hide it and comes back instantly when you summon it
• Converted Markdown no longer starts with a block of file details, and PDF export from Markdown tells you when it fails
android_changelog:
v7.3.0

• Your PC's newest three copies arrive after you were away, newest on top
• Text from your PC lands on the floating clipboard and your phone's clipboard straight away, even in the background
• Text from your PC is never sent back to it as a new copy
• Notes: what you write is its own entry, a new card on your PC; edits survive leaving the screen or closing the app
• Screenshots reach your PC whole, and only once
• Files, images, PDFs and videos from your PC now finish downloading
• Faster switch from Wi-Fi to cloud, and a connection status you can trust
• New search, recently deleted, page organizer and image viewer, with a refreshed look and motion
